name: github-app help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:github-app. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: App name
entries.text: What the GitHub App is called on github.com.

entries.title: Create GitHub App
entries.text: Opens GitHub to make the app in one click; it comes back here with its keys. After that no session needs a personal token.

entries.title: Check installation
entries.text: Checks the app is installed on your repos and can push.

entries.title: Mint a token now
entries.text: Makes a fresh short-lived token from the app, to test it works.

entries.title: Forget the app here
entries.text: Removes the app's keys from this console. The app on GitHub stays.
